average-crit.description: Expected crit multiplier with crit rate capped at 100%; crit damage is nonnegative.

emblem-er.description: At two pieces, add 0.20 ER before conversions and bonus evaluation.

emblem-burst-bonus.description: At four pieces, Burst DMG bonus is one quarter of effective ER, capped at 0.75 (75%).

example-hp-flat-damage.description: Illustrative additive base damage proportional to effective HP; coefficient is an explicit scenario parameter, not a real kit claim.

atk-cryo-crit.description: Explicit encoded approximation preserving the previous numerical proxy; output unit follows its primary scaling stat.

hp-cryo-crit.description: Explicit encoded approximation preserving the previous numerical proxy; output unit follows its primary scaling stat.

atk-hp-added-cryo.description: Illustrates base ATK damage plus an HP-derived additive term before ordinary bonus and crit factors.

coverage_gaps.use: Executable expression engine and full set-effect coverage
coverage_gaps.reason: v4 encodes arithmetic and activation only. Runtime compilation, unit checking, and most set/character effects are not implemented; no deletion integration or full damage simulation is implied.

unit_convention: All machine-readable percentage stats and bonuses are decimal ratios. Source prose may use % notation; normalize it once before authoring numerical entries.
